text:
mira (partnerships): Quick sync — SI partner Nimbus is ready for marketplace listing but legal wants proof of KMS/HSM key ownership model and SCIM mapping. Can security confirm gating checklist? cc @ben :wave:

ben (security): Thanks, @mira. I started a short checklist, need two things: (1) key custody model (BYOK vs provider-managed) with key policy sample, (2) SCIM claim mapping for groups/orgs. I can own the KMS doc.

alex (eng): For HSM integration: Nimbus will use a connector to our secrets API. We need to ensure their HSM certificate + attestation is on file. Also confirm crypto algorithms supported (RSA-PSS + ECDSA).

mira (partnerships): Got it — legal also asked for an abbreviated runbook for key rotation and incident contact list. They want it before we put joint listing live.

ben (security): Drafting rotation runbook now. Short version below, can someone confirm payloads for rotation API?

alex (eng): Rotation flow (summary):
```
1) request new key from partner HSM (via PKCS11/REST)
2) upload public key to Redwood KMS as external key reference
3) update key alias in staging routes, run smoke tests
4) flip alias in prod, monitor latency/errors for 30m
```
I can drop exact curl examples tomorrow.

jordan (platform): Also add one more gating item: CI/CD credentials scoping. Marketplace listing requires a service principal with least privilege for onboarding scripts. Nimbus has a wide scope now.

mira (partnerships): Good catch. @onboard-bot can you attach the latest partner-gating checklist and the legal template link?

onboard-bot: Attached -> https://redwood.internal/partners/checklists/nimbus-gating (permissions: partnerships, security, legal) :white_check_mark:

ben (security): SCIM mapping: Nimbus uses groupName -> groups.displayName and userName -> emails[0].value. We need them to add externalId and confirm case-sensitivity on usernames. Sample mapping: `{"userName": "emails[0].value", "externalId": "id"}`. If they cannot provide externalId, we recommend `scim-external-id:<org>-<id>` prefixing.

mira (partnerships): Legal also requested a short paragraph on liability boundaries re: BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys. @ben can you propose language?

ben (security): Draft liab paragraph: "When customers opt for BYOK or partner-hosted HSMs, the custody and lifecycle of cryptographic material remains the responsibility of the key owner. Redwood's platform provides integration, routing, and audit logging for keys but does not assume custody or indemnity for external key storage unless explicitly agreed in a contractual addendum." Feedback welcome.

alex (eng): Looks fine. I'll add a tech note about how we surface key usage in logs (key-id redacted) and where to find audit trails in Console -> Security -> Key Usage.

mira (partnerships): Risk/legal also want proof-of-concept screenshots for SCIM provisioning creating groups + one sample SCIM push. Can Nimbus provide a staging account?

jordan (platform): We can stand up a short-lived staging tenant and create a scoped API key for them. Will need a PR with terraform changes to grant just `provisioning.write` scope.

mira (partnerships): Timeline? Nimbus wants listing by EOW next week. Realistic?

alex (eng): Tight but doable if Nimbus spins up staging and we get credentials by tomorrow. I can queue the curl examples tonight:
```bash
# SCIM test user create
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"test@nimbus.co","name":{"givenName":"Test","familyName":"User"}}' \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Users
```

ben (security): One more note: we need their HSM attestation doc (FIPS level / module cert) and the sig of the device firmware. Without attestation we can't approve BYOK in prod.

mira (partnerships): I'll ping Nimbus legal and ops now. @ben @alex @jordan — please mark anything you need in the checklist link. I'll update legal and set a hard freeze date if any items remain open by Friday. :calendar:

onboard-bot: Checklist status: 3/8 items complete (KMS policy draft, SCIM mapping sample, staging tenant provision requested). Remaining: HSM attestation, rotation screenshots, CI scoping change, legal paragraph approval.

jordan (platform): I'll provision the staging tenant once Nimbus confirms the account. Leaving a note: use `partner-staging-<org>` prefix and TTL 14d.

mira (partnerships): Thanks team. Sync tomorrow 9am if things aren't green. Otherwise I'll coordinate pre-announce copy with marketing after legal signs off. :rocket:
